"Remove paths

And 

Implement Dual Cultivation Realm System.

1. SPIRIT CULTIVATION — 15 REALMS

Replace the existing Spirit realm list with these exact 15 realms:

0. Mortal
1. Qi Condensation
2. Foundation Establishment
3. Golden Core
4. Nascent Soul
5. Soul Transformation
6. Spirit Severing
7. Void Refinement
8. Dao Integration
9. Tribulation Transcendence
10. True Immortal
11. Celestial Immortal
12. Immortal Sovereign
13. Immortal Emperor
14. Primordial Immortal
15. Eternal Dao Ancestor

Mortal is the initial state and has no Roman numeral stages

Every realm has 10 stages:
I, II, III, IV, V, VI, VII, VIII, IX, X.

2. BODY CULTIVATION — 15 REALMS

Create a completely independent Body Cultivation progression with these exact 15 realms:

1. Mortal Body
2. Skin Tempering
3. Muscle Tempering
4. Bone Tempering
5. Organ Tempering
6. Blood Refinement
7. Marrow Cleansing
8. Meridian Forging
9. Diamond Body
10. Saint Body
11. Divine Body
12. Immortal Body
13. Celestial Body
14. Primordial Body
15. Eternal Godbody

Body realms have 10 stages (I–X).

3. BODY CULTIVATION UNLOCK

- Initially, only Spirit Cultivation is available.
- Body Cultivation unlocks when the player reaches Golden Core I.
- Before unlocking, display Body Cultivation as locked.
- Once unlocked, the player starts at Mortal Body.
- Both paths progress independently.

4. SHARED QI SYSTEM

Both cultivation paths must use the same Qi resource.

- Spirit upgrades consume Qi.
- Body upgrades consume Qi.
- Each path has its own upgrade costs.
- Players decide which path to develop.
- Never create separate Qi currencies.

5. STAGE ADVANCEMENT

- Stages I–IX advance through guaranteed Qi upgrades.
- Stage X is the final stage of each realm.
- Advancing from X to the next realm I requires a major breakthrough.
- Create scalable Qi requirements for all 15 realms.
- Higher realms must become progressively more expensive.

6. MAJOR BREAKTHROUGH SYSTEM

Create separate breakthrough mechanics for Spirit and Body.

Spirit Breakthrough

- Heavenly tribulation challenge.
- Spiritual lightning effects.
- Spirit attributes and Dao comprehension influence success.
- Tribulation Pills and Formation Hall improve success chances.

Body Breakthrough

- Physical tempering challenge.
- Survive damage waves or physical endurance trials.
- Body attributes and Body Tempering Technique influence success.
- Show a different visual effect from Spirit breakthroughs.

Breakthrough outcomes

Success:

- Advance to the next realm at Stage I.
- Award permanent attribute improvements.

Critical Success:

- Advance to the next realm.
- Grant additional permanent attributes or rare rewards.

Failure:

- Remain at the current realm Stage X.
- Lose 10% of accumulated Qi.

Success probability:

- Minimum: 20%.
- Maximum: 95%.
- Include relevant attributes, techniques, pills and sect bonuses.
- Prevent bonuses from being counted multiple times.




---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

Existing implementation is actually pretty thorough. Main gaps relative to request:

1. "Remove paths" — remove the paths page/nav (old foundation path training) probably.
2. Spirit list should include Mortal explicitly as index 0, no numerals, and all other realms shifted by 1; Golden Core at index 3. Body unlock at Golden Core I should use index 3. This is the explicit exact list requirement. Existing has 15 entries starting at Qi Condensation, and displays Mortal only via realmTitle? Actually default display says Qi Condensation I. Need fix.

3. Body unlock external labels "Golden Core I", check index. Body realm list exactly matches.

4. Major breakthroughs: success advances next realm I. Good. Failure remain X and lose 10% qi. Good. Success probability min 20 max 95. Good. Spirit chance includes attributes, Dao, pills, Formation Hall. Body chance includes body attributes, technique, meridians, formation. Good. "Prevent bonuses from being counted multiple times." Current spirit chance counts upgrades.body (Jade Body Tempering) + formation + breakBuff + root break + meridian break + pathTree + daoTree + sect blessing + pathLevels spirit + water dao etc. Distinct sources. Fine. But Formation Hall counted once. Good.

5. Stage I-IX guaranteed upgrades. Existing yes. Need Mortal special. Qi costs scalable. Existing cost formula. But with 16 realms, max stage higher; formula uses realm*10. fine.

6. Breakthrough costs: current breakthroughCost uses nextRealm, so from current x X cost = base * 1.085^(nextRealm*10) * 1.22^nextRealm *3. Good.

7. Body unlock display: before unlocking show locked. Existing yes.

8. Same Qi. yes.

9. Remove separate Qi currencies. Existing single state.qi. yes.

## Objective
- Remove the old Paths feature and implement independent Spirit and Body cultivation progressions that share Qi, with realm advancement and breakthrough mechanics.

## Requirements
- Spirit progression: Mortal initial state with no stages, followed by the 15 specified realms, each with stages I–X.
- Body progression: the 15 specified realms, each with stages I–X; unlock at Golden Core I and begin at Mortal Body.
- Both paths use the same Qi pool, with independent upgrade costs and progression.
- Guaranteed Qi advances through stages I–IX; Stage X requires a major breakthrough with scalable costs.
- Separate Spirit tribulation and Body tempering breakthroughs; bounded 20–95% success chance, success/critical success rewards, and failure loses 10% of accumulated Qi.
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Treated “Remove paths” as removing the old Cultivation Paths navigation/view and path-training/tree progression.
- Added Mortal as an initial Spirit state before the 15 named Spirit cultivation realms.
- Migrated older saves by shifting existing dual-cultivation Spirit realm indices and persisting the normalized save.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `game.js` with the revised Spirit list, independent Body progression, shared-Qi advancement, costs, unlock threshold, breakthrough chance calculations, outcomes, and save migration.
- Removed the Paths UI and old path progression section, training function, and action handler.
- Updated realm display, codex, character sheet, stage indicators, and relevant descriptions for Mortal/no-stage handling and 15 numbered Spirit realms.
- Ran `node --check game.js`; performed browser checks and saved screenshots under `screenshots/`.

### Active
- Review final changes and verify that all breakthrough effects, outcomes, costs, and listed realms match the request; provide the user with a concise completion summary.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `git status` and the final diff for unintended changes or leftover references to the removed Paths feature.
2. Run final syntax and gameplay checks, especially breakthrough success/failure/critical rewards and unlock behavior.
3. Report assumptions and verification results; note that changes are uncommitted unless repository state indicates otherwise.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: cultivation data, save migration, costs, progression, breakthroughs, rendering, and removal of old Paths logic.
- `index.html`: removed Paths navigation item and view.
- `styles.css`: updated Spirit realm-path layout and Mortal stage-pip styling.
- `screenshots/`: browser-check screenshots created during implementation.

## Important Context
- Spirit realm data now contains Mortal plus the 15 named cultivation realms; body data contains 15 realms.
- Body unlock threshold is `GOLDEN_CORE_REALM = 3`, corresponding to Golden Core I in the updated Spirit indexing.
- The assistant described a 6% per-stage and 14% per-realm cost growth, with realm breakthroughs costing three times the next realm’s Stage I cost.
- The user’s requested change has not yet received a final response.

## Objective
- Remove the old Cultivation Paths feature and implement independent Spirit and Body cultivation progressions that share Qi, with realm advancement and breakthrough mechanics.

## Requirements
- Spirit starts at Mortal with no stages, then follows 15 specified realms with stages I–X.
- Body has 15 specified realms with stages I–X, unlocks at Golden Core I, and starts at Mortal Body I.
- Spirit and Body use shared Qi but advance independently.
- Stages I–IX advance reliably; Stage X requires a major breakthrough with scalable costs.
- Separate Spirit tribulation and Body tempering breakthroughs; success chance is bounded to 20–95%, with success/critical rewards and 10% Qi loss on failure.

## Decisions
- Removed the old Cultivation Paths navigation/view, training action, tree progression, and associated stat bonuses; retained unrelated Dao paths.
- Added Mortal as the Spirit starting state and shifted old save realm indices during migration.
- Set stage-cost scaling to 6% per stage and 14% per realm; major breakthrough cost is 3× the next realm’s Stage I cost.
- Bumped save version to 4, removed legacy `pathLevels`, and persisted normalized saves to prevent repeated migration.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented Spirit and Body progression, shared-Qi costs, unlock behavior, breakthrough chances/outcomes/rewards, rendering, codex/character updates, and save migration.
- Removed the old Paths UI and progression logic; legacy `data-view="paths"` links redirect to Cultivate.
- Verified `node --check game.js`, `git diff --check`, and headless browser checks for progression, breakthroughs, Paths removal, and old-save migration.
- Checked desktop and mobile rendering with screenshots.

- `game.js`: cultivation data, progression, breakthroughs, save migration, rendering, and legacy Paths removal.
- `index.html`: removed Paths navigation and view markup.
- `styles.css`: updated Spirit realm layout and Mortal stage styling.
- `screenshots/`: browser-rendering captures, including `final-desktop.png` and `final-mobile.png`.

- Body unlock threshold is `GOLDEN_CORE_REALM = 3` with Mortal at Spirit realm index 0.
- Final verification passed all checks; one initial toast assertion was corrected to match the actual failure message, “The tribulation resists.”
- Changes are uncommitted in `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css`.
